Department: Project Management

What You’ll Get

  • Clear promotion opportunities. We invest heavily in training and promote almost exclusively from within. Most leaders at Spiralyze started in entry‑level roles.

  • In‑demand skills. You’ll learn Conversion Rate Optimization from the most experienced experimentation teams in the world.
  • Time to recharge. 20 days of paid vacation plus holidays.

If you’re excited about working with smart people, solving real problems, and growing fast in a merit‑based environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Sobre a Eurofins

A Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida, fornecendo uma gama exclusiva de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores, para tornar a vida e o ambiente mais seguros, saudáveis e sustentáveis. A Eurofins acredita que é líder global em testes de produtos alimentícios, ambientais, farmacêuticos e cosméticos e em serviços de agrociência CRO. É também um dos líderes mundiais independentes de mercado em determinados serviços de testes e laboratório para genômica, farmacologia de descoberta, forense, CDMO, ciências avançadas de materiais e no apoio a estudos clínicos.

Em apenas 30 anos, a Eurofins cresceu de um laboratório em Nantes, França, para mais de 61.000 funcionários em uma rede de mais de 1.000 empresas independentes em mais de 59 países e operando mais de 940 laboratórios. A Eurofins oferece um portfólio de mais de 200.000 métodos analíticos para avaliar a segurança, identidade, composição, autenticidade, origem, rastreabilidade e pureza de substâncias e produtos biológicos, além de fornecer serviços inovadores de testes de diagnóstico clínico, como um dos principais players emergentes globais em teste de diagnóstico clínico especializado.

Em 2021, a Eurofins gerou receita total de EUR 6,7 bilhões e está entre as ações com melhor desempenho na Europa nos últimos 20 anos.

title: Technical Implementation Owner
description:
About Us

Join us at Orange Business! We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business. Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

About The Role

TIO is the Technical Implementation Owner part of OCD GSOC Organization, and Orange Business CSU Organization, manages customer expectations according to service sold and acts as the main technical point of contact for the customer and the project team (from order to delivery). The TIO delivers managed security solutions to Orange Cyberdefense customers. The TIO implements the managed solutions through the different management platforms. The role of the Technician Implementation Owner is responsible for participating in projects to activate Managed Security Services purchased by customers. The Technician Implementation Owner will ensure that both Customer-, Orange Cyberdefense-, Vendor environments/platforms are setup in accordance with pre‑defined project plans, associated instructions, and timeline. The Technician Implementation Owner will also have the opportunity to collaborate cross‑functionally with colleagues in the Orange Cyberdefense organization as there are various roles that collaborate within one Onboarding project.

Key Responsibilities

  • Presales Phase
    • Reviews the proposal and delivery model with presales support
    • Provides the Level of Effort of the build phase
    • Proposes the management architecture for some managed offers
    • Validates the timeline and potential training needs
    • Contributes to service creation or evolution (PoC/PoV)
  • Project Kickoff
    • Validates non‑standard requests with ISS and Engineering
    • Reviews the BoM and request the vendor quotes for the fully managed solutions
    • Participates in project internal and external kickoff meetings
    • Helps the security consultant collecting the technical requirements
    • Aligns the project timeline and deliverables with OCD PM
    • Provide Technical Guidance for the customer and the project team
  • Deployment and configuration

      • Reviews the security design
      • Works with L3 Engineering to deliver new PoC/Bespoke solutions
      • Validates the nonstandard management approaches with ISS
      • Implements the managed security scope of work
    • Operational Platform
      • Reviews the existing design, the customer environment, and the proposed changes
      • Aligns the needed changes with the involved stakeholders complying with the complex change management process
      • Implements the managed security scope of work
  • Service Activation and Project Closure
    • Manages the rollout plans with the customer and OCD PM
    • Tests the security scope with the customer and any other relevant stakeholderProvides post implementation support
    • Initiates the HOTO process with the Operations team and Security Manager including the handover sessions and Knowledge Transfer
  • Service Disconnection
    • Coordinates and performs the disconnection tasks for complex disconnections needed for running managed services in collaboration with the TIO colleagues.
  • Quality
    • Ensure that Services can be delivered according to the project timeline
    • Ensure that Service deliverables are in accordance with the project plan
    • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to receive‑, provide‑ and take action on activities within the projects. Stakeholders include (but is not limited to):
    • Security Operations Teams (SOC)
    • HOTO Process
    • Knowledge Transfer
    • Alignment on operational changes
    • Security PMs
      • Project Governance
      • Dispatch Requests
      • Purchase Orders
      • Logistics
    • Release Program
      • HW Refresh (EoS or Vulnerability)
      • End of contract disconnect request
    • Technical Management (ISS)
      • License Management
      • SMA / SDP Changes
      • Access Requests
    • Security Engineering
      • Technical Validations
      • Instructions Manuals
      • Deployment support for PoCs/Bespoke
    • Security Managers
      • Alignment on operational changes
      • Change of operational platform design
      • HOTO Process
    • Security Consultants
      • Project Design Phase
      • Collecting Technical Requirements
    • OCD Presales
      • Level of Effort of Managed Security Offers
      • Validating OCD Scope of Work
      • Validating BoM for procurement
      • Provide Vendor Quotation for some Costing

About You

  • Highly organized/structured, follow‑through on commitments and with a strong sense of responsibility for your own- and the team’s overall performance
  • Ability to work and communicate effectively in English (both written and spoken) and with excellent Customer communication skills
  • Have a positive and helpful attitude and always strive to leave a good impression
  • Able to remain calm and focused in potentially stressful situations
  • Solution oriented and leaves nothing to chance, to stay ahead of potential challenges
  • Curious and not afraid of asking questions or initiate discussions

Must have

  • Advanced networking skills, very good understanding of TCP/IP, routing, switching and SDWAN
  • Expert Network Security Skills
  • Advanced / Fluent English (written and spoken)
  • Very good communication skills
  • Sound customer facing experience
  • Certification in Network Security or Vendor relevant certifications
  • At least 3 years hands‑on experience with one or more of the following solutions:
    • Firewalls (Fortinet, Palo Alto, CheckPoint, Juniper, Cisco)
    • SASE (Palo Alto Prisma Access)
    • F5 (LTM, GTM, WAF)
    • Remote Access Solutions (Ivanti)
    • SSE (Zscaler)
    • Antivirus and Antimalware
    • IDS & IDP
    • URL & Content filtering solutions.
    • Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS)

Good to have

  • Project Management skills (Senior TIO)

Experience/Certifications

  • Certification in Network Security or Vendor relevant certifications
  • ITILv4
  • PRINCE2 Agile
  • ISO 27001

You bring a can‑do attitude, tackle challenges head‑on and challenge the status quo with new and innovative ideas.

What We Offer

The benefits of being Orange

Orange Business was certified as one of the best companies to work by the Great Place to Work Institute from 2012 to 2015. Since 2016, Orange has been awarded as the Top Employer Brazil. The comprehensive independent research revealed that the Company provides excellent employee conditions, nurtures and develops talent throughout all levels of the organization, and has demonstrated its leadership status in the HR environment, always striving to optimize its employment practices and to develop its employees. Only Your Skills Matter

Monitorar as calibrações de equipamentos e instrumentos do processo fabril.

Quem somos nós?

Somos a JDE Peet’s. Nós produzimos um café para cada xícara e desenvolvemos marcas para cada coração.

A JDE Peet’s é a principal empresa global dedicada exclusivamente ao café, servindo aproximadamente 4.400 xícaras de café por segundo em mais de 100 mercados. Guiados pela nossa estratégia “Reviver o Incrível”, focamos em um crescimento liderado por marcas com três grandes apostas: Peet’s, L’OR e Jacobs, além de um portfólio de 9 ícones locais, como Douwe Egberts, Kenco, Pilão, Old Town, Moccona, Super, Gevalia, Friele e Marcilla.
Em 2024, a JDE Peet’s gerou 8,8 bilhões de euros em vendas e contava com mais de 21 mil colaboradores no mundo todo.

No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.

Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet’s?

Visão geral

Essa posição visa uma atuação estratégica e multifuncional nas áreas de análise de riscos, controles internos e auditoria.

Responsabilidades

  • Identificação e análise de riscos corporativos: Avaliar, priorizar e propor estratégias de mitigação de riscos operacionais, financeiros, regulatórios e estratégicos, alinhadas ao retorno sobre investimento (ROI) e ao apetite ao risco organizacional;
  • Desenvolvimento de estratégias de mitigação: Desenhar e implementar medidas específicas para tratar exposições ao risco, ajustando-as conforme mudanças internas e externas e garantindo a eficácia dos controles;
  • Monitoramento contínuo: Supervisionar e revisar regularmente as estratégias de tratamento de risco implementadas, garantindo a adaptação às dinâmicas do negócio e às exigências regulatórias;
  • Gestão de controles internos: Implantar políticas e processos robustos que garantam conformidade regulatória, mitigação de riscos e aprimoramento da governança corporativa;
  • Auditoria interna: Realizar auditorias preventivas e investigativas, apoiando a identificação de áreas críticas e propondo melhorias;
  • Comunicação e relatórios: Elaborar relatórios claros e transparentes para manter líderes e stakeholders informados sobre os principais riscos, oportunidades e ações tomadas;
  • Planos de contingência e resposta a incidentes: Participar do desenvolvimento e da execução de planos de continuidade de negócios (BCP) e recuperação de desastres (DRP), minimizando impactos adversos em situações críticas;
  • Atualização e capacitação profissional: Manter-se atualizado em tendências, tecnologias e melhores práticas de gestão de riscos no mercado e promover treinamentos dentro da organização para assegurar que todos compreendam seu papel na mitigação de riscos

Sobre o Grupo Profarma

Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou-se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição. Comprometidos com a promoção da saúde e do bem-estar, nossas equipes trabalham diariamente para oferecer experiências inclusivas, sustentáveis e socialmente engajadas. Seja de forma presencial ou por canais digitais, desenvolvemos soluções e serviços inovadores que nos posicionam como a melhor escolha para nossos parceiros. Afinal, entregar saúde é o nosso propósito.

Diversidade e Inclusão no Grupo Profarma

Acreditamos que enxergar é mais do que ver - é reconhecer as singularidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Por isso, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade & Inclusão por meio do programa Diversidade em Cena.

Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso para todos, valorizando as diferenças de gênero, etnia, deficiências, orientação sexual (LGBTI+), crenças, religiões e outras individualidades.

Quer fazer parte dessa jornada com a gente? Junte-se ao Grupo Profarma!

Acreditamos na promoção de uma organização mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva, em que todos se sintam confortáveis para serem, verdadeiramente, quem são e possam despertar todo o seu potencial. Isto significa que não toleramos qualquer tipo de discriminação com base em raça ou etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica diversa e protegida por lei.

Ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos associados, priorizamos DE&I no centro dos nossos processos de pessoas. Isso nos permite promover o respeito e eliminar qualquer preconceito ou ação discriminatória, garantindo uma experiência inclusiva no ambiente de trabalho. Não hesite em entrar em contato se precisar de qualquer suporte durante o processo de recrutamento.

Descrição da empresa

Quem somos nós?

Somos a JDE Peet’s. Nós produzimos um café para cada xícara e desenvolvemos marcas para cada coração.

A JDE Peet’s é a principal empresa global dedicada exclusivamente ao café, servindo aproximadamente 4.400 xícaras de café por segundo em mais de 100 mercados. Guiados pela nossa estratégia “Reviver o Incrível”, focamos em um crescimento liderado por marcas com três grandes apostas: Peet’s, L’OR e Jacobs, além de um portfólio de 9 ícones locais, como Douwe Egberts, Kenco, Pilão, Old Town, Moccona, Super, Gevalia, Friele e Marcilla.
Em 2024, a JDE Peet’s gerou 8,8 bilhões de euros em vendas e contava com mais de 21 mil colaboradores no mundo todo.

No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.

Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet’s?

Acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor de uma xícara de café.
Juntos, criamos esses momentos todos os dias, transformando ideias em impacto e possibilidades em realidade. Na JDE Peet’s, trabalhamos como um só time, guiados por nossos valores: Ouse Encantar, Seja Dono, Simplifique e Vencer Juntos. Aqui, você encontra liberdade para inovar, coragem para dar passos ousados e apoio para desenvolver sua carreira em um ambiente global.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time e descubra qual é a sua xícara de momentos incríveis!

Talan is an international consulting group specializing in innovation and business transformation through technology. With over 7,200 consultants in 21 countries and a turnover of €850M, we are committed to delivering impactful, future-ready solutions.

Talan at a Glance

Headquartered in Paris and operating globally, Talan combines technology, innovation, and empowerment to deliver measurable results for our clients. Over the past 22 years, we’ve built a strong presence in the IT and consulting landscape, and we’re on track to reach €1 billion in revenue this year.

Our Core Areas of Expertise

  • Data & Technologies: We design and implement large-scale, end-to-end architecture and data solutions, including data integration, data science, visualization, Big Data, AI, and Generative AI.

We work with major global clients across diverse sectors, including Transport & Logistics, Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Retail, and Media & Telecommunications.

Role summary

We are looking for a Business Analyst to join our FX IT Tribe. While prior experience in the FX sector is not mandatory, we highly value proactive individuals who are eager to learn and quickly adapt to a dynamic environment.

Key responsibilities

  • Support analysis of FX business processes and translate needs into user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Assist Product Owner and dev team in backlog refinement and prioritisation.

  • Prepare reports and presentations to support decision-making.
  • Support or perform Scrum Master-related tasks when needed to ensure smooth delivery.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Native or fluent Spanish (mandatory) and professional-level English.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to write clear, well-structured user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Proactive attitude with strong ownership and effective stakeholder communication skills.

Valuable experience (nice to have)

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.
  • Experience in FX, payments, cash management or other transactional financial solutions.
  • Hands‑on experience working with APIs (REST, JSON, Swagger/OpenAPI, API consumers).
  • Experience defining contracts, error handling and non‑functional requirements for APIs.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Postman.

Additional Information

What do we offer you?

  • Full time contract
  • Training and career development.
  • Possibility to be part of a multicultural team and work on international projects.

title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team. Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance.

Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings.

The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems.

Location

This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc)
  • Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning
  • Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders
  • Being an advocate of, and advancing, modern software development practices
  • Participating in the engineering process through code and architectural review
  • Engaging with broader teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners
  • Travelling to internal and external global events for 4 to 6 weeks per year

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages
  • Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S
  • Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies
  • Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue
  • Data Center infrastructure management and design

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Na SGS, oferecemos a mais ampla gama de soluções de teste, inspeção e certificação para as indústrias de ciência agrícola, alimentos, ciências da saúde e cosméticos e higiene.

Recursos Naturais – Possibilitando eficiência e sustentabilidade nas indústrias agrícola, de mineração, petróleo, gás e química. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Business Assurance – Transformar os negócios e viabilizar o crescimento sustentável aprimorando conhecimento, habilidades e processos com certificação, auditorias de fornecedores, avaliações de sustentabilidade, consultoria e treinamento. Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the‑art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

This role blends analytical skills with a strong understanding of digital content and marketing to create, plan, implement, and optimize content strategies that drive brand positioning and enrollment growth. Reporting directly to the Content Marketing Manager, this role is integral to supporting the Marketing team at the São Paulo campus, ensuring that all content aligns with Avenues’ mission and branding philosophies, with strong ownership over Avenues São Paulo’s digital content presence and a high standard of editorial judgment and strategic thinking.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for developing and managing implementation schedules and strategic actions to ensure timely and effective content delivery across channels (including social media, email campaigns, website, and blog articles) in alignment with overall marketing objectives.
  • Monitors, collects, and analyzes performance data (traffic, engagement, conversions, etc.) across channels to produce comprehensive reports with actionable insights and recommendations for content optimization and campaign improvements.
  • Creates, publishes, and manages written and visual content tailored to different audiences, in the form of website updates, blog articles, email marketing, social media posts/messages, campaigns etc, ensuring alignment with Avenues’ brand, tone, and marketing objectives.
  • Owns the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of digital content across platforms, ensuring high editorial standards and strategic alignment with enrollment and brand objectives.
  • Conducts competitive research and monitors public sentiment and digital trends to identify opportunities for differentiation, growth, and audience engagement.
  • Manages and maintains a content calendar to ensure timely, strategic, and consistent content delivery aligned with marketing initiatives and key admissions dates and events.
  • Supports multimedia content production, including video and photo shooting and editing, to deliver high‑quality, impactful digital assets.
  • Monitors and manages the online community by responding to comments, messages, and inquiries, fostering positive interactions and building an engaged digital audience.
  • Collaborates with external PR and marketing agencies to ensure alignment of our messaging, strategy, and goals.
  • Engages with faculty and academic teams to understand classroom experiences and learning practices, translating them into accurate, compelling, and authentic content narratives.
  • Collaborates closely with Admissions and Marketing to interpret content performance in relation to enrollment goals, supporting data‑informed decisions across the admissions funnel.
  • Continuously monitors trends in content marketing, social media, and digital analytics, translating insights and performance data into strategic evolution of content formats, channels, and narratives.

Qualifications

  • Fluent in both Portuguese and English.
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to write, edit, and adapt high‑quality content fluently in both English and Portuguese for different audiences and channels.
  • Solid experience in a Marketing and Social Media role.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and Premiere.
  • A degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong Verbal and Written Communication Skills.
  • Experience using CRM and analytics tools (such as HubSpot and Salesforce) to inform content strategy and performance optimization.
  • Experience with Google Ads/Analytics, Meta, CRM, and SEO.
  • Extreme attention to detail and organization with proven project management skills, from ideation to completion in a fast‑growing, quick‑moving environment, and the ability to prioritize.
  • A desire to work as part of a highly collaborative and can‑do team, a hands‑on, entrepreneurial approach, and eager to roll up your sleeves and tackle challenges.
  • A results‑oriented, collaborative approach to project management.
  • Experience in education is desirable but not required. A strong interest in school routines and innovative educational methodologies is essential.

Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

Pré-venda é uma área de apoio às Vendas, que faz a qualificação dos leads em parâmetros técnicos e situacionais. É de suma importância no processo comercial, pois antes de dar sequência à negociação, faz o filtro dos prospects que estão prontos tecnicamente e no momento certo para comprar. Isso faz com que chegue às mãos do vendedor somente os melhores leads, aumentando a taxa de fechamento de vendas.

Em Pré Vendas, existem cargos específicos em encontrar os potenciais clientes que se enquadram no nosso perfil de cliente, e estão no momento de compra. Essa qualificação e segmentação dos leads pode ser realizada de várias formas, por profissionais distintos.

Main responsibilities

Procuramos um Representante de Desenvolvimento de Negócios (BDR) em São Paulo Capital para se juntar à nossa equipe! Você será a pessoa chave para encontrar e atrair novos clientes , ajudando a impulsionar o crescimento da empresa.

Sua missão será ir atrás das melhores oportunidades, utilizando diversas estratégias, como BANT e Spin, para se conectar com futuros clientes:

Seu principal objetivo é identificar e qualificar leads , ou seja, descobrir quais contatos realmente têm grande potencial e interesse em nossos produtos ou serviços. Depois de encontrar essas "oportunidades de ouro", você as encaminhará para nossa equipe de vendas, que então irá fechar o negócio.

Esta é uma posição estratégica, pois você terá a liberdade de explorar novos mercados e segmentos , o que pode resultar em parcerias e vendas de maior valor . Se você tem brilho nos olhos por novos desafios e adora abrir portas, essa vaga é para você!

Sobre a Associação Renal Vida

Fundada em06 de fevereiro de 2003 , a Associação Renal Vida nasceu com o propósito de oferecertratamento digno às pessoas com doenças renais . Com o passar dos anos, sua missão se expandiu parapromover a saúde e melhorar a qualidade de vida , acompanhando as transformações da sociedade e os desafios impostos pelo aumento das doenças renais, hoje reconhecidas mundialmente como um grave problema de saúde pública.

Segundo aAssociação Brasileira dos Centros de Diálise e Transplante (ABCDT) , cerca de10% da população sofre de algum tipo de doença renal crônica.

Na Renal Vida, acreditamos que o cuidado vai além do tratamento clínico. Oferecemosatenção, acolhimento, respeito e suporte emocional , fortalecendo vínculos e construindo relações humanas baseadas em confiança e empatia.

Com sedes emBlumenau, Brusque, Itajaí, Rio do Sul e Timbó , a Associação Renal Vida atende75 municípios de Santa Catarina e realiza o acompanhamentopré e pós-transplante de pacientes em todo o Brasil. Em parceria com oHospital Santa Isabel , a instituição tem orgulho de já tersuperado a marca de 2692 transplantes renais realizados , reafirmando seu compromisso com a vida, a excelência no cuidado e a promoção da saúde.

Missão

Melhorar a vida das pessoas, oferecendo esperança e humanização.

Visão e Futuro

Ser o mais eficiente HUB de saúde RENAL do Brasil.

  • Senso de pertencimento

Buscamos um profissional para atuar como SOLDADOR em nossa unidade localizada em TELÊMACO BORBA/PR.

  • Realizar o corte de peças metálicas conforme especificações técnicas, utilizando técnicas e equipamentos apropriados, como oxicorte ou plasma;
  • Garantir a precisão e qualidade dos cortes, seguindo as normas de segurança estabelecidas;
  • Realizar soldagem em aço carbono e aço inox, bem como em outros materiais, como furos, chapas e equipamentos;
  • Utilizar uma variedade de processos de soldagem, incluindo eletrodo revestido, TIG, MIG, MAG, arco submerso, brasagem e plasma, conforme a necessidade e especificações do trabalho;
  • Seguir rigorosamente os procedimentos de segurança durante todas as atividades de soldagem, garantindo a proteção pessoal e a integridade das instalações e equipamentos;
  • Assegurar a qualidade das soldas, realizando inspeções visuais e testes não destrutivos, conforme necessário.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Escolaridade: Ensino médio completo;
  • Necessário ter transporte próprio.
  • Diferencial: Curso de soldagem;
  • 6 meses de experiência comprovada em soldagem em diferentes materiais e processos;

Há duas décadas, a Metrum tem se destacado em fornecer soluções completas para o Mercado de Energia Elétrica. Nosso time é formado por pessoas apaixonadas, colaborativas e que acreditam no trabalho #carregadodeenergia, com foco em autonomia e responsabilidade!

Se você busca um ambiente ágil, desafiador e com oportunidades de desenvolvimento, essa é a sua chance!

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento básico em gerenciamento de servidores Windows(Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Hyper-V)

  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura cloudAzure, Azure AD, AD Conect,Microsoft 365
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de backup corporativo
  • Conhecimento em Banco de dados

BENEFÍCIOS

Temos vários restaurantes na região e o almoço é garantido pelo Vale Refeição. Após o almoço, você pode descansar e aproveitar a nossa área de jogos.

Vale Mobilidade para recarregar seu cartão de ônibus de acordo com sua necessidade ou ajudar na gasolina.

A Metrum se preocupa com a saúde do colaborador, por isso oferecemos Plano de Saúde coparticipativo, sem mensalidade. E não podemos esquecer do Plano Odontológico e do Seguro de Vida em grupo.

O Gympass complementa nossa preocupação com a saúde dos colaboradores, oferecendo acesso a academias e atividades físicas em diversas localidades, promovendo bem-estar e qualidade de vida.

Oferecemos um Cartão Farmácia, que pode ser usado nas principais drogarias e o valor é descontado na folha de pagamento.

Quer fazer um curso superior ou encarar uma pós-graduação? A Metrum tem parceria com faculdades presenciais e digitais, oferecendo descontos para os colaboradores e dependentes, além da possibilidade de bolsas de estudo.

Na Metrum, acreditamos que o colaborador está no pilar da construção de uma boa empresa, por isso, anualmente, temos uma Premiação financeira de acordo com o seu desenvolvimento.

Ter corpo e mente descansados é importante e pensando nisso, temos uma parceria com o SESC-MG, que oferece lazer e cuidados com a saúde.

Venha fazer parte do Time Metrum!

Marília - A Saneflux, empresa de sistemas de tratamento de esgoto e efluentes, promove na próxima segunda-feira, 22 de setembro, em Marília ação de contratações com 24 vagas de emprego .

O atendimento vai acontecer das 10h às 16h, na sede da empresa, localizada na Rua Moacir Simões, 285 – Distrito Industrial – Jardim Santa Antonieta, em Marília.

As oportunidades atendem candidatos com ensino fundamental completo, sendo que 15 das 24 vagas exigem disponibilidade para viagens. Todas as posições são para atuação em funções operacionais.

Os interessados devem comparecer ao local munidos de documentos pessoais, carteira de trabalho e um currículo atualizado. Não é necessário agendamento prévio.

A ação de contratação tem apoio da Prefeitura de Marília e a secretario do Trabalho, Turismo e Desenvolvimento Econômico atua na divulgação.

O secretário, Vitor Gazola, destacou trabalho para ampliar acesso a oferta de vagas e ao suporte pelo PAT (Posto de Atendimento ao Trabalhador).

A empresa reforça que a contratação é imediata e que os selecionados passarão por treinamentos específicos para o desempenho das funções.

title: Farmacêutico
description:
O Farmacêutico é responsável por garantir a qualidade e segurança dos medicamentos e produtos utilizados nos tratamentos de infertilidade oferecidos pela clínica. Este profissional atua na supervisão da manipulação e distribuição de medicamentos, orientando a equipe e os pacientes sobre o uso correto e seguro dos produtos farmacêuticos, além de garantir o cumprimento das normas e regulamentações da área.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação em Farmácia, com registro ativo no conselho de classe (CRF).
  • Experiência prévia em farmácia hospitalar ou clínica, preferencialmente na área de saúde.
  • Conhecimento em legislação farmacêutica e boas práticas de manipulação.
  • Habilidade de comunicação e empatia para atender os pacientes.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes.

Atividades e responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar a manipulação, armazenamento e distribuição de medicamentos e insumos.
  • Realizar a análise e controle de qualidade dos produtos farmacêuticos utilizados na clínica.
  • Fornecer orientações e informações sobre medicamentos, suas indicações e contraindicações, tanto para a equipe quanto para os pacientes.
  • Ser responsável pelo controle de estoque e pela compra de medicamentos, garantindo níveis adequados, validade e rastreabilidade.
  • Realizar o controle, registro e cumprimento das exigências da Portaria nº 344/98, assegurando a correta guarda, movimentação e documentação dos medicamentos sujeitos a controle especial.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas e regulamentações da Anvisa e outras instituições competentes.
  • Colaborar com a equipe médica na escolha dos tratamentos e medicamentos mais adequados para os pacientes.
  • Monitorar e avaliar a eficácia dos tratamentos em andamento, propondo ajustes quando necessário.
  • Participar de treinamentos e capacitações para a equipe, promovendo a atualização sobre novos medicamentos e práticas.
  • Contribuir para a disseminação da cultura e dos valores da empresa, garantindo um atendimento humanizado e de qualidade.

Acolhida/Contato Inicial com o Aprendiz, Família, Escola e Equipe Multidisciplinar

  • Realizar acolhimento inicial das famílias e dos clientes, escutando e legitimando queixas e expectativas para alinhamento com a intervenção proposta.

Avaliação e Desenvolvimento do Plano Terapêutico

  • Estabelecer vínculo com o cliente antes de iniciar o processo de avaliação, a fim de garantir maior fidedignidade nas análises realizadas.

  • Definir carga horária e local de atendimento do cliente, em conjunto com a equipe interdisciplinar.

Intervenção

  • Implementar o plano terapêutico individualizado, realizando a seleção, indicação e aplicação de métodos, técnicas e procedimentos terapêuticos adequados para crianças e adolescentes com TEA, com suporte da supervisão técnica.

  • Demonstrar humildade para reconhecer erros e disposição para aprender e crescer profissionalmente.

description:
The Retail Operations Manager is the in‑market Brand Expert responsible for supporting franchise partners across multiple countries and regions. This role ensures that global strategies are translated into consistent, high‑quality execution in diverse cultural, commercial, and operational environments. Operating as the brand owner’s representative in‑market, the Retail Operations Manager partners closely with franchise Field Leadership Teams to drive sales growth, elevate customer experience, uphold brand standards, and build long‑term capability across a portfolio of international markets. They serve as the critical connector between global strategy, regional priorities, and the customer experience delivered in stores across countries.

Responsibilities

Grow & Drive Business: Deliver consistent sales growth across multiple countries

  • Influence sales performance across a portfolio of international markets by leveraging business analysis and optimizing KPIs unique to each country.
  • Align with the Regional Commercial Manager and franchise partners across regions on action plans from Weekly Business Reviews, integrating weekly sales results by country, category, and store.
  • Provide market‑specific insights and seasonal hindsight to International and Regional Commercial teams, highlighting differences in consumer behavior, competitive dynamics, and promotional effectiveness across countries.
  • Create customer intimacy through time spent in stores across diverse markets, reinforcing training tools and demonstrating how to foster a customer‑centric culture adapted to local norms.
  • Ensure brand standards are consistently upheld across countries, incorporating cultural and operational differences; review daily store photos from multiple markets and partner with franchise leaders to drive follow‑up actions.
  • Build a disciplined, execution‑focused culture across all assigned markets, identifying cross‑country opportunities and sharing best practices across regions.

Capability: Drive operational excellence across varied market environments

  • Support partners in new store openings across different countries, ensuring consistent brand standards despite varying local regulations, labor practices, and operational models.
  • Escalate critical issues impacting performance in any market and collaborate with the Regional Commercial Manager and global teams to remove obstacles, expedite solutions, and ensure operational excellence across regions.

Talent & Culture: Build capability across diverse franchise leadership teams

  • Participate in talent recruitment and succession planning across multiple countries, understanding differences in talent pools, leadership norms, and labor markets.
  • Assess strengths and gaps in franchise Field Leadership Teams across regions; influence partner actions to address capability gaps in each market.
  • Coach and train partner leaders across countries to deliver a consistent, branded customer experience while adapting to local cultural expectations and customer behaviors.
  • Conduct regular store visits across markets, providing in‑store coaching, behavior modeling, and follow‑up to ensure consistent execution of the selling model and visual standards internationally.

Partnerships: Strengthen relationships across international franchise partners

  • Provide timely communication and participate in weekly and monthly business reviews across multiple countries, ensuring alignment with global and regional priorities.
  • Cascade information across markets, ensuring franchise partners in each country are informed and prepared to execute customer‑facing brand activities, initiatives, and strategies.

Why This Role Matters

The Retail Operations Manager is the in-market brand guardian, ensuring that global strategies translate into flawless store execution and exceptional customer experiences. By coaching and developing franchise field and store leaders, they influence sales growth, uphold brand standards, and build sustainable capability in-market. This role also strengthens franchise partnerships by providing insight, escalating issues, and ensuring operational excellence. The Retail Operations Manager is the critical connector between global strategy and the customer experience in stores.

The ROM is unique because, while their in-market peers are employed by the franchise partner, they themselves represent the brand owner. They partner with the FLT/SLT, but with a mandate to coach, influence, and elevate back to the Regional Commercial Manager and global teams.

Qualifications & Experience

The job requires a background of 5 to 7 years in Retail Operations/Field Management, with a preference for experience in Franchise (partner) operations or managing multiple store locations.

  • Previous experience in fashion/beauty highly desired
  • Proven record in talent development and influence
  • Ability to quickly analyze key business metrics and results to identify performance improvement opportunities and recommend meaningful solutions
  • Capable of fostering customer closeness through a keen understanding of brand and customer awareness
  • Proficient communication abilities and the skill to cultivate successful business relationships

  • Arquitetar Fluxos de GTM: Desenhar, construir e manter fluxos de trabalho técnicos avançados que alimentam o enriquecimento, pontuação (scoring), gatilhos de campanha e programas de outreach em múltiplos canais;

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Sphere Labs The infrastructure moving the world's money today was built for another era: slow rails, walls between markets, and compliance layered in over time creating friction. Sphere Labs is building what comes next: modern, compliance-native infrastructure for cross-border payments and settlement, designed from the ground up to work for the businesses and regulated institutions it actually runs through. We work in active partnership with banks, licensed entities, and the regulators and jurisdictions shaping how global money moves, because the infrastructure that earns institutional trust has to be built alongside it. Backed by Coinbase, Kraken, The Chernin Group, Jump Trading, Hudson River Trading, and some of the world's largest sovereign affiliates, we're a fully remote, global team building at the moment stablecoins are crossing into mainstream finance and regulated institutions are ready for modern rails. We hire self-starters: strong communicators and systematic thinkers who can look at a blank page and build something real. If you want a meaningful role in how global money movement evolves, and the upside that comes with getting in early, we'd like to meet you.

The Role

We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to lead our go-to-market efforts in Brazil. This is a high-impact, senior individual contributor role for a proven enterprise seller who understands the Brazilian payments ecosystem inside and out—and sees where stablecoins fit into its future. You'll own the full sales cycle from identifying opportunities to closing multi-year enterprise deals. Your targets are the fintechs, banks, and payment service providers (PSPs) that are shaping Brazil's financial infrastructure. You'll sell to senior finance and payments leaders, helping them understand how stablecoin rails can reduce costs, accelerate settlement, and unlock new revenue streams. This is a building role. You'll be instrumental in defining our Brazil GTM strategy, informing product development for the region, and establishing Sphere as the trusted infrastructure partner for stablecoin payments in Latin America's largest economy.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Full Sales Cycle

    Identify, prospect, and close enterprise deals with fintechs, banks, PSPs, and large corporates in Brazil. Manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes with procurement, legal, compliance, treasury, and C‑suite buyers. Run discovery, demos, commercial negotiations, pilot programs, and implementation handoffs. Consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.

  • Build & Manage Pipeline

    Leverage your existing network in Brazil's payments ecosystem to generate qualified opportunities. Develop territory and account plans that prioritize high-value, strategic accounts. Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene and deliver accurate forecasts. Identify and manage local referral partners in the FX industry. Partner with Marketing on targeted campaigns, events, and content for the Brazilian market.

  • Sell Value at the Executive Level

    Position stablecoin infrastructure as a strategic advantage—articulating FX savings, settlement speed, treasury optimization, and new product opportunities. Build business cases and ROI models tailored to each prospect's operations. Develop trusted relationships with CFOs, Heads of Treasury, Heads of Payments, and Chief Product Officers. Navigate regulatory and compliance conversations with confidence.

  • Be the Voice of Brazil

    Represent Sphere at industry events, conferences, and in media engagements across Brazil. Provide market intelligence on competitive dynamics, regulatory developments (BCB, CVM), and customer needs. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Compliance to ensure our platform meets the specific requirements of Brazilian customers. Contribute to building a world-class sales playbook for the region.

What We’re Looking For

  • Must Have 8+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota selling to fintechs, banks, or PSPs.
  • Deep payments and FX experience — you understand cross-border flows, treasury operations, correspondent banking pain points, and how money moves in and out of Brazil.
  • Crypto/stablecoin experience — you've sold blockchain infrastructure, digital assets, or crypto-enabled payments products (or you've been a buyer of these solutions).
  • Existing relationships in Brazil's payments ecosystem — you have a book of business and a network of senior contacts at target accounts that you can activate from Day 1.
  • Full‑cycle enterprise selling skills — you're equally comfortable sourcing your own pipeline, running a technical demo, negotiating an MSA, and quarterbacking a pilot.
  • Native Portuguese fluency and professional English proficiency.
  • Based in Brazil , ideally São Paulo, with willingness to travel internationally.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to or working at Tier 1 Brazilian banks (Itaú, Bradesco, Santander, BTG) or leading fintechs (Nubank, PicPay, Mercado Pago, Stone, PagSeguro).
  • Understanding of Brazilian regulatory landscape — BCB instant payments (Pix), CVM regulations, crypto licensing developments.
  • Background in treasury, FX trading, or payments operations.
  • Experience at a high-growth startup scaling in Brazil.
  • Spanish proficiency for broader LATAM opportunities.

The Profile

You thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You're not waiting for inbound leads—you're building your own pipeline from relationships you've cultivated over years in the market. You can credibly speak to a Head of Treasury about FX exposure and settlement risk, then pivot to explaining stablecoin rails to a Chief Product Officer exploring embedded finance. You're entrepreneurial but disciplined. You bring structure to chaos—territory plans, account maps, forecasting rigor—while staying flexible enough to adapt as we learn what works in the market. You believe stablecoins are the future of payments infrastructure, and you want to be at the forefront of that shift in Latin America's most important market.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. Nosso legado é ambicioso: construir o melhor ecossistema bancário em tecnologia e atendimento para empresas no Brasil. Essa posição exige visão sistêmica para conectar integrações complexas (ex.: Banco Central, bandeiras, processadoras e APIs) à experiência final do cliente, garantindo alinhamento entre estratégia, execução e comunicação interna e externa.

Mid-Level Full Stack Engineer (U$D) – ID #298

4 March, 2026

Brasil, Sao Paulo, Hybrid 90% (2 days by month/Office)

About the Role

We are looking for a Mid-Level Full Stack Engineer to join a long-term digital agriculture initiative based in the U.S.

The team develops a platform that analyzes weather, soil, and field data to help farmers identify potential yield-limiting factors and make data-driven decisions.

This is an opportunity to work on impactful technology within the Agrotech space, combining modern cloud architecture, scalable backend systems, and intuitive web interfaces.

About the Team

You will be part of a large, multidisciplinary engineering organization composed of specialists in web development, backend systems, data analysis, and mobile applications.

Teams are highly collaborative and agile, working together to solve complex technical challenges while taking ownership of different areas of the product.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain full stack applications deployed on AWS.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, designers, SMEs, and other engineers across the full development lifecycle (requirements, development, testing, deployment).
  • Analyze user stories and contribute to sprint estimation and planning.
  • Implement features and ensure delivery aligned with sprint goals.
  • Write unit tests and contribute to ongoing testing initiatives.
  • Support applications following DevSecOps practices.
  • Participate in continuous improvement of architecture and deployment workflows.
  • Contribute to onboarding new business models into the platform.

Basic Qualifications

  • Intermediate to advanced English communication skills.
  • Self‑motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working with modern and legacy systems.
  • Strong team collaboration mindset.
  • Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills with attention to detail.

Technical Requirements

  • 4–6 years of experience in software development.
  • Proficiency in React.js, TypeScript, and Node.js .
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS , including:
    • Amazon RDS
    • DynamoDB
    • SNS and SQS
    • AWS Lambda
    • Amazon ECS
    • CloudWatch
    • CloudFormation
  • Experience working with NoSQL databases.
  • Familiarity with Material Design principles.
  • Experience deploying and managing cloud-native applications.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with microservices architecture.
  • Exposure to scalable, data-intensive platforms.

What We Offer

  • Long-term opportunity within a growing Agrotech initiative.
  • Exposure to modern AWS-based cloud architecture.
  • Collaborative and innovation-driven engineering culture.
  • Professional growth within a large-scale product environment.

title: PROGRAMA BANCO DE TALENTOS: COORDENADOR DE LABORATÓRIO
description:
Descrição da empresa Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida, fornecendo uma gama exclusiva de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores, para tornar a vida e o ambiente mais seguros, saudáveis e sustentáveis. Desde os alimentos que você come, até a água que você bebe, e os medicamentos nos quais você confia, a Eurofins trabalha com as maiores empresas do mundo para garantir que os produtos fornecidos sejam seguros, seus ingredientes autênticos e a rotulagem exata. A Eurofins acredita que é líder global em testes de produtos alimentícios, ambientais, farmacêuticos e cosméticos e em serviços de agrociência CRO. É também um dos líderes mundiais independentes de mercado em determinados serviços de testes e laboratório para genômica, farmacologia de descoberta, forense, CDMO, ciências avançadas de materiais e no apoio a estudos clínicos. Em apenas 30 anos, a Eurofins cresceu de um laboratório em Nantes, França, para mais de 50.000 funcionários em uma rede de mais de 900 empresas independentes em mais de 50 países e operando mais de 800 laboratórios. A Eurofins oferece um portfólio de mais de 200.000 métodos analíticos para avaliar a segurança, identidade, composição, autenticidade, origem, rastreabilidade e pureza de substâncias e produtos biológicos, além de fornecer serviços inovadores de testes de diagnóstico clínico, como um dos principais players emergentes globais em teste de diagnóstico clínico especializado. Em 2020, a Eurofins gerou receita total de EUR 5,4 bilhões e está entre as ações com melhor desempenho na Europa nos últimos 20 anos.

Coordenar as atividades do laboratório, assegurando o atendimento dos requisitos técnicos e da ABNT NBR ISO/IEC 17025, ABNT NBR ISO 14001 e ABNT NBR ISO 45001 com foco na gestão de pessoas, relação com clientes e suprimentos. Reporting to: Head – Assisted Growth Programs & Product

About Wadhwani Accelerate

Wadhwani Accelerate works with growth-oriented SMEs to helps them scale revenues, enter new markets, expand in domestic and export marketsand overcome execution bottlenecks that hyper growth companies typically face. Our model focuses on productizing growth consulting by standardizing recurring growth challenges into structured, outcome-oriented service offeringsdelivered by curated experts.

Role Overview

The Manager – Services Development will play acritical role in building and scaling the “services layer” of Wadhwani Accelerate’s Assisted Growth Programs.

The role sits at the intersection of product design, expert network development, and service delivery enablement . The individualwill help convert growth challenges faced by SMEs into clearly defined, repeatable service offerings and build a high-quality panel of domain expertswho can deliver these services across regions.

This is a builder role suited for someone who enjoys creating structure out of complexity , working closely with experts, and scaling professional services in a semi-productized model.

Key Responsibilities

1. Services & Product Development

  • Workwith the Program Head – Accelerate to translate growth archetypes (e.g., export expansion, domestic scaling, channel growth, customer segmentation) into structured service offerings.
  • Helpdefine service “modules” across key execution hurdles such as:
    • Working capital & finance
    • Sales process & capability
    • Market entry & channel strategy
    • Product readiness & positioning
    • Regulatory & compliance
  • Support the creation of a service matrix (growth archetype × execution hurdle) and clearly articulate scope, outcomes, effort, and delivery format for each service.
  • Assist in defining differentiated service bundles for Accelerate Select, Accelerate Core cohorts based on advisory hours, delivery format, and expert seniority.

2. Expert Network Building & Management

  • Identify, onboard, and manage a curated panel of regional and national experts across domains such as exports, sales growth, compliance, finance, and product strategy.
  • Build strong working relationships with experts across Gujarat, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Uttar Pradesh.
  • Define engagement models for experts (retainer, per-assignment, cohort-based delivery, workshops, 1:1 advisory).
  • Ensure experts are aligned to Wadhwani Accelerate’s service standards, outcomes, and delivery formats.

3. Service Enablement & Quality Assurance

  • Work with program and operations teams to ensure smooth deployment of services to ventures.
  • Help standardize service delivery through playbooks, templates, diagnostic frameworks, and checklists.
  • Monitor service quality, expert effectiveness, and venture feedback to continuously improve offerings.
  • Support pilots of new services and refine them before scaling.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Program, Partnerships, Impact, and Operations teams to align services with cohort needs and outcomes.
  • Provide inputs into pricing logic, effort estimation, and scalability considerations for services.
  • Support internal documentation and knowledge management for service offerings.

Candidate Profile

Education & Experience

  • MBA from a reputed institute.
  • 5–7 years of work experience in consulting, SME advisory, professional services, program management, or ecosystem-focused roles.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strong ability to structure ambiguous problems into clear service offerings.
  • Experience working with or managing external experts, consultants, or partners .
  • Understanding of SME growth challenges in areas such as sales, exports, finance, or compliance.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • High execution orientation with attention to detail and follow-through.

Mindset Fit

  • Comfortable operating in a build-from-scratch, evolving environment .
  • Interested in scaling impact through systems and platforms, not just bespoke consulting.
  • Entrepreneurial, collaborative, and outcomes-driven.

Why This Role is Unique

  • Opportunity to build a first-of-its-kind productized SME growth services model in India.
  • Exposure to diverse sectors, geographies, and growth challenges.
  • Direct influence on how thousands of SMEs access high-quality growth support at scale.

description:
Descrição

Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Hardware RFID para liderar a frente de infraestrutura física de um projeto de alta complexidade de rastreamento de volumes em terminais de cargas aeroportuário. O profissional será a referência técnica para a escolha, dimensionamento, testes e validação de todos os dispositivos RFID (leitores, antenas, coletores de dados, impressoras térmicas e tags). Será responsável por garantir que o hardware suporte o alto volume operacional e cumpra os rigorosos SLAs de recebimento, armazenagem e expedição de importação e exportação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Seleção e Especificação Técnica: Definir os modelos ideais de equipamentos junto aos fornecedores (como Zebra, Viaonda, etc.), englobando:
  • Leitores fixos industriais de 8 portas para portais de leitura.
  • Antenas de alto ganho (ex: polarização circular/linear) e cabos,
  • Coletores de dados (Mobile) com sistema operacional Android.
  • Impressoras de transferência térmica RFID UHF de alto volume (203dpi), avaliando tecnologias híbridas e "On-Metal" (ex: Linha Zebra ZT400/ZT411).
  • Homologação de Insumos (Tags): Especificar etiquetas RFID UHF padrão EPC Gen2 / ISO 18000-6C adequadas para múltiplas superfícies, desde papelão e plástico para cargas gerais, até tags especiais "On-Metal" (ex: Família Silverline) para Racks e ULDs aeronáuticos.
  • Execução de Site Survey: Conduzir o levantamento em campo no terminal para definir a localização exata dos portais, validar quantidades de antenas por zona (ex: transelevadores TE/TZ, câmaras frias e docas), e especificar barreiras mecânicas e proteção contra vazamento/interferência de radiofrequência.
  • Implantação e Configuração: Realizar a instalação lógica, ativação e testes unitários/integrados de todos os leitores e equipamentos acessórios nos portais RFID.
  • Testes e Validação: Elaborar relatórios técnicos e planos de teste (Cutover), garantindo que a comunicação entre a etiqueta e a antena ocorra na distância e velocidade exigidas pela operação.
  • Treinamento e Go-Live: Elaborar documentação técnica (manuais) das configurações, treinar usuários multiplicadores na aplicação de etiquetas e operação do hardware, e acompanhar a operação inicial assistida (Go-Live).

Requisitos e qualificações

Hard Skills

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Telecomunicações, Mecatrônica, Automação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência comprovada com tecnologia RFID UHF (Ultra High Frequency) e profundo conhecimento dos padrões globais.EPC Gen 2 (ISO 18000-6C)
  • Experiência prática com hardwares de prateleira (Leitores Zebra, Impinj, Coletores robustos, Impressoras de etiquetas industriais).
  • Vivência na execução de Site Survey para RF e mitigação de interferências em ambientes logísticos ou industriais complexos.
  • Conhecimento sobre física de RF, compreendendo como os sinais reagem em presença de metais, líquidos e diferentes densidades de materiais.

Soft Skills

  • Pensamento analítico e capacidade de resolução de problemas técnicos complexos.
  • Rigor técnico e alta atenção a detalhes em ambientes de alta criticidade operacional.
  • Organização e planejamento para condução de implantações, testes e validações de infraestrutura.
  • Comunicação técnica clara com equipes multidisciplinares (operações, tecnologia e fornecedores).
  • Capacidade de colaboração em projetos que envolvem integração entre hardware, software e processos logísticos.
  • Autonomia e senso de responsabilidade na condução de decisões técnicas e resolução de incidentes.
  • Adaptabilidade para atuar em ambientes logísticos e industriais dinâmicos.
  • Orientação para resultado e confiabilidade operacional das soluções implantadas.

title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.
POSITION SUMMARY - This position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, Peru
Over the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity; and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.
Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy-based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green-gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean-climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean-climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.
Responsibilities
International Ocean Policy

  • Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green-gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean-climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.
  • Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean-climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.
  • Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.
  • Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.
  • Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.g., side events, meetings with countries and partners).
  • Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships with government representatives and like-minded organizations to accelerate and achieve CI ocean policy objectives in close coordination with CI’s international policy team and relevant country programs.
Ocean Policy Advancement in Priority Countries
  • In partnership with CI country programs, the International Blue Carbon Institute, and the Center for Policy and Incentives, support the development and implementation of national or regional ocean policy objectives and programs which are aligned with and inform CI’s Blue Climate and broader policy priorities.
  • Provide CI programs and partners with strategic support, technical expertise, and/or capacity building for the integration of coastal ecosystems into Nationally Determined Contributions and implementation plans, national climate and ocean policy, greenhouse gas inventories, NBSAPs and other related components of ocean-climate policy.
  • As needed, facilitate in-person and virtual meetings, workshops, and related events with national governments and local partners to advance the priorities of CI country programs in alignment with national objectives.
  • Support the Ocean Policy Director in scoping new policy activities in accordance with existing CI programs.
Blue Climate Program
  • Contribute to strategy development, planning processes, fundraising, team initiatives/special projects, reporting and communication efforts as needed.
  • Coordinate with other teams across the Blue Climate network team to ensure programmatic alignment and synergies between CI projects.
Other duties as assigned by supervisor.
WORKING CONDITIONS
  • Frequent international travel (25% or more) is required.
  • Ability to work in remote locations or under difficult working conditions.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some days remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.
  • Requires working remotely with colleagues in other locations and time zones.
  • Flexible working hours: Frequent early morning and evening meetings, and occasional work over weekends, to accommodate colleagues in other time zones or high-level policy events.
  • This position follows a hybrid work structure, working some days from the office and some remotely. Guidance will be shared during the interview process.
Qualifications
Required
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5 to 7 years of experience working in international climate and/or ocean policy mechanisms and fora.
  • Understanding of government processes and the overall policy engagement environment.
  • Strong organization, project management, and prioritization skills.
  • Excellent time management skills and ability to adapt in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse, international team.
  • Experience partnering with, and influencing, key stakeholders and building strong partnerships across public and private sectors and civil society.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, and ability to effectively communicate complex information to a diverse audience.
  • Enthusiasm and capacity for learning scientific and related basis for specific conservation outcomes as needed to support policy priorities and processes.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
Preferred
  • Bi-lingual or multilingual in official UN languages.
  • Expertise in coastal blue carbon and marine ecosystems, climate change science, and/or nature-based solutions
  • Master's degree or other advanced degree in environmental policy or related field.
  • Experience working globally in a range of cultural settings.

description:
Calvary International Church (São Paulo, Brazil) – Lead Pastor

The Big Picture

Calvary International Church (calvary.org.br) is a faithful English‑speaking international congregation seeking a full‑time Lead Pastor who will preach the Word of God in an expository manner, graciously shepherd the congregation, and provide godly leadership.

The Church

The church was established in 1961 by a group of members from Perdizes Baptist Church to minister to the growing number of English‑speaking families that were moving to São Paulo. It was founded on traditional Baptist principles and doctrine. Today, the congregation is made up of representatives from over 15 nations, with different socio‑economic and religious backgrounds, all gathering for the purpose of corporate worship, fellowship and being equipped to go out and share the gospel of Jesus with the world. Presently, Sunday morning worship attendance is between 250 and 300 with two service times being offered, 8:30 am and 11:00 am. Of those in attendance, 120 are resident members. Demographically, around 60% of the congregation is Brazilian, mostly 3rd culture, and 40% foreign. We livestream our services online, as well as provide access to recorded messages. We have a full program of worship, Sunday School, community groups, and activities for children and youth. The church has both elders and deacons. The Lead Pastor serves alongside non‑vocational elders in a manner consistent with Elder‑Led Congregationalism.

The Qualifications

The Pastor must fulfill the qualifications of the office of an Elder as outlined in 1 Timothy 3:1‑7 and Titus 1:6‑9. Previous experience in a ministry role for at least five years is highly desired. A seminary degree is preferred or, at minimum, a bachelor in Bible or ministry‑related field. He must exhibit in daily life the fruit of the Spirit as found in Galatians 5:22 and display ongoing growth in sanctification, spiritual wisdom, and the knowledge of God’s will. Be able to preach, teach, and converse fluently, comfortably, and clearly in English. Be comfortable in conversational Portuguese (or be willing to intentionally pursue language study over the first years of ministry). Be able to teach orthodox, Biblical truth in agreement with Calvary’s Statement of Faith.

Descrição da Empresa

Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida, fornecendo uma gama exclusiva de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores, para tornar a vida e o ambiente mais seguros, saudáveis e sustentáveis. Desde os alimentos que você come, até a água que você bebe, e os medicamentos nos quais você confia, a Eurofins trabalha com as maiores empresas do mundo para garantir que os produtos fornecidos sejam seguros, seus ingredientes autênticos e a rotulagem exata. A Eurofins acredita que é líder global em testes de produtos alimentícios, ambientais, farmacêuticos e cosméticos e em serviços de agrociência CRO. É também um dos líderes mundiais independentes de mercado em determinados serviços de testes e laboratório para genômica, farmacologia de descoberta, forense, CDMO, ciências avançadas de materiais e no apoio a estudos clínicos.

Em apenas 30 anos, a Eurofins cresceu de um laboratório em Nantes, França, para mais de 50.000 funcionários em uma rede de mais de 900 empresas independentes em mais de 50 países e operando mais de 800 laboratórios. A Eurofins oferece um portfólio de mais de 200.000 métodos analíticos para avaliar a segurança, identidade, composição, autenticidade, origem, rastreabilidade e pureza de substâncias e produtos biológicos, além de fornecer serviços inovadores de testes de diagnóstico clínico, como um dos principais players emergentes globais em teste de diagnóstico clínico especializado.

Em 2020, a Eurofins gerou receita total de EUR 5,4 bilhões e está entre as ações com melhor desempenho na Europa nos últimos 20 anos.

Gerenciar as áreas operacionais do laboratório. Acompanhar e aprovar o desenvolvimento e aprimoramento de processos e métodos, esclarecer dúvidas técnicas em geral, estudar e propor compra de novos equipamentos, bem como apoiar as relações comerciais.
